description: Replace engine oil and filter, reset service indicator
Drain, flush and refill cooling system with OAT (Red/Pink)
app_action: Check coolant level, schedule full replacement

description: Replace timing belt, tensioner, water pump (if driven) - Belt
Check chain stretch, tensioner, guides - listen for rattle
Replace fuel filter (diesel critical for pump protection)
Replace spark plugs - Nickel / Platinum gap 0.9-1.1 mm
Perform compression test: 12.1-13.9 bar, max diff 1.4 bar. Check fuel pressure 3.1 bar, oil pressure idle 1.58 bar

description: Join reminders on engine_code to generate user-specific schedule. App should calculate next due = last_service_date + interval OR last_service_km + interval, whichever first.
app_action: Implement notification logic: days_remaining = (last_date + months*30) - today; km_remaining = (last_km + interval_km) - current_km
